ns2:section.sectionText: Dealing with Dictators: Morality and the National Interest This course seeks to combine current events, history, and political science to understand and evaluate a key issue in US foreign policy: the tension between America?s pursuit of its ?national interest? and its desire to promote its values. Focus will be on US relationships with authoritarian states in general, but will also take a look at specific cases. This course will examine the effectiveness of foreign aid, democracy-promotion policies, other forms of diplomacy, and military intervention in accomplishing US foreign policy objectives.
